mustFix.problem: The fixed gauge at bottom-left covers review quote text and the lot-check kicker at 1440
mustFix.fix: Reserve a left gutter (padding-inline-start: 96px on .wrap at >=1024px) or move the gauge outside the content column on the right; hide or dock it into the header below 1200px so it never overlaps text

mustFix.problem: The FIG caption plate sits over the drawing's own label row (FOOTING · SLAB · DRAIN · SURFACE; 4 STEPS · 11 FT DROP), so the labels are half-hidden
mustFix.fix: Move the caption below the frame as a figcaption, or lift the drawing's label row above the caption height so both read in full

elevate.move: Grow the elevation gauge into a full-height altitude rail in the 1440 left gutter; every section kicker hangs off it at its elevation and section gaps scale with altitude gained, so the full page reads as an ascending mountain profile and the empty services column and touching dark bands become one deliberate spine

Redraw the story figures and the lot-check result in the ridge-break language (layered flat planes, the three greens, a horizon, hatched cut-section footings) so river to ridge reads as one illustrated uphill sequence, and give the lot-check a designed result plate in that language
